Files, source use and network practice

Unit 1 · Week 15 · Lesson 3 · Suggested 55-minute plan; adjust to local timing.

Prepare: Open the consolidation chapter and its learning resources. Use paper or a local editor as appropriate, with fictional data and disposable practice copies. The suggested 55-minute lesson is flexible.

Suggested answers are teacher guidance, not extra assessment tasks. These notes are public.

1. Files, source use and network practice

Suggested time: 2 minutes

Instructional strategy: Learning intention

Explain the goal and the expected independent outcome. Connect operational requirements to useful evidence. This is ungraded textbook learning. Suggested times can be adjusted to the class. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#consolidation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.

2. Retrieval and explanation

Suggested time: 5 minutes

Instructional strategy: Individual retrieval, then partner comparison

Write mode truncates existing contents. Visible source alone does not grant a licence. Use the current textbook licence guidance and recorded permissions. Allow silent thinking before discussion. Ask a learner to justify an answer before revealing the explanation. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#consolidation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.

3. Requirement and evidence

Suggested time: 6 minutes

Instructional strategy: Worked table and teacher explanation

These are independent evidence checks. A screenshot that a screen opened cannot establish all of them. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#consolidation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.

4. The second-run failure

Suggested time: 10 minutes

Instructional strategy: Predict, model and explain

Inspect truncating mode and when the file is opened. Correct in a disposable copy and verify two separate records persist. Pause for predictions before discussing the expected result. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#consolidation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.

5. A library explanation

Suggested time: 10 minutes

Instructional strategy: Guided paired practice

Use station E and the existing support booklet. Keep the traffic policy and application/file permissions distinct. Swap explaining and checking roles so both learners articulate the reasoning. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#consolidation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.

6. Independent practice

Suggested time: 12 minutes

Instructional strategy: Independent application with optional support

Provide the project workbook and course symbol reference. Written network reasoning does not replace the required drawing practice. Offer the relevant worked example if needed, then use a changed case to check independent understanding. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#consolidation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.

7. A choice to explain

Suggested time: 5 minutes

Instructional strategy: Whole-class response and justification

B. Attribution and permission answer different questions. Avoid inventing a blanket rule about every copyright exception. Give thinking time and collect reasons, without recording scores. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#consolidation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.

8. Exit explanation

Suggested time: 5 minutes

Instructional strategy: Individual reflection and fresh explanation

Look for a precise test or source check connected to the claimed result. Use the response to select the next explanation or practice activity. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#consolidation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.
